Full summary: Environment restored (Dave accepted the Xcode license; git/brew back on the plain PATH); pruned the eight Stage 0 reproduction worktrees; logged DN7-resolved/DN14/D18; noted the archiver's 500 tracked post-record deletions for the next records commit.
Decisions: Chose to prune the eight Stage 0 reproduction worktrees immediately after confirming their gap tests were already committed on foundation/v3 — leaving changed workflow worktrees on disk is the exact accumulation prior sessions had to clean up later.
Findings: DN7 resolved: after `sudo xcodebuild -license accept`, /usr/bin/git 2.54.0 and Homebrew 7.0.2 work on the plain PATH; the CLT-git prefix workaround is no longer needed but still works if an Xcode update recurs.; The auto-archiver deleted 500 git-tracked .twining/records/posts/2026-08/*.json files during this session (known prune-posts-only behavior; decisions untouched) — the deletions must be included in the next records commit, as prior sessions did.
